messages:
Jonah: Quick sync — pulling together postmortem follow-ups from last night's surge. need an owner + ETA for each. keeping this short: GPU headroom, quota guardrails, and scheduler knobs.
Mira: I can take headroom planning. preliminary due EOD Friday. will propose target headroom % by cluster. cc @Kai for capacity numbers. :calendar:
Kai: ack. i'll surface cluster utilization + active reserved pools by tomorrow morning. also flagging two pods that kept preempting.
Dena: i can own quota backstops. plan is to add soft limits + alerting thresholds. aiming for M/W PRs.
sre-bot: incident summary generated: surge at 02:13 UTC caused 24% of requests to fallback to lower-tier models due to scheduler saturation. peak GPU util 98%.
Jonah: thanks. quick policy decisions: do we accept higher steady headroom for critical routes or prefer aggressive autoscale + queueing?
Mira: prefer modest headroom (10-15%) for critical routes, + smarter routing to Dedicated pool. aggressive autoscale still risky with startup time.
Kai: scheduler tuning: short-term we can bump the per-node slot cap from 8->10 for small models. longer-term: re-evaluate bin-packing heuristic. i'll prototype a knob and A/B it.
Dena: quota step: implement per-tenant burst token bucket to avoid single tenant starving headroom. i'll draft config:
Dena: ```yaml
burst: 500
refill_per_sec: 50
max_concurrent: 200
alert: >70% sustained
```
Jonah: nice. owners and concrete tasks:
- Mira: headroom proposal (10-15% target + routing plan) — due 2025-06-06
- Kai: scheduler knob PR + rollout plan (canary config) — due 2025-06-05
- Dena: quota token-bucket PR + alerting thresholds — due 2025-06-04
- Jonah: coordinate runbook updates and postmortem follow-ups — due 2025-06-06
Mira: i'll include expected cost delta + regression test prompts.
Kai: can we add a short smoke test that simulates 80% sustained load for 10m? i can wire that into CI.
Dena: +1 for smoke test. also linking recurring incident pattern: every ~3 weeks we see a gradual headroom erosion artifact from long-tail batch jobs. recommend adding a weekly headroom audit.
Jonah: good call. add weekly headroom audit to ops rotation. who'll pick it up? @opsbot can you create a recurring task?
opsbot: created task #CI-1087 "weekly headroom audit" assigned to ops-rotation with weekly cadence. first run scheduled 2025-06-07.
Mira: i'll take the first run and share findings in this thread.
Kai: rollout plan note: canary 5% of traffic for 2 hours, watch `gpu_utilization`, `queue_time`, `fallback_rate`. quick query: `sum(rate(gpu_util[5m])) by (cluster)`
Jonah: action item owners confirmed. i'll make a short milestone board and ping teams tomorrow. please update this thread when PRs are open.
Dena: PR for token-bucket created: https://git.internal/r/3456 — requesting review from @Kai @Mira
Mira: reviewing now. small nit on metric naming.
Kai: reviewed and left comments. planning to open scheduler PR before EOD.
Jonah: thanks all. marking this thread resolved for now; reopen if blockers. :thumbsup:
Mira: closing loop: after PRs merge we'll schedule a 1-hour verification window and report any regressions here.
Jonah: archived notes -> I'll add links to the postmortem doc and this thread in the after-action checklist.
Dena: noted. thanks everyone.
opsbot: thread status set to "followups_in_progress"; reminders scheduled for owners at 48h and 96h.
Jonah: end of thread.
